text:
I read all 10 tracked files. Findings are ranked by severity. I didn't build or run the site, so I haven't checked the output Next.js actually renders. ## High 1. **The pricing page is set to noindex but is listed in the sitemap.** - `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. The same line sets a self-canonical, and `public/sitemap.xml:4` lists the URL. - These signals contradict each other, and the page that answers "how much does Ledger cost" is hidden from search and AI answers. - **Fix:** remove `robots` from the pricing metadata. If you really do want it hidden, drop it from the sitemap and the canonical too. 2. **The blog is invisible to crawlers.** - `app/blog/page.tsx:1-10` is a `'use client'` page that loads posts in `useEffect` from `/api/posts`. The server HTML contains only `

Blog

`, so AI crawlers, which mostly don't run JavaScript, see no posts. - There is no `/api/posts` route in the repo, so the page may render empty even in a browser. - The page can't export `metadata` because it is a client component. It inherits the generic layout title and description (`app/layout.tsx:4-5`). - Titles are plain text, with no links or per-post URLs, and the sitemap has no post entries. - **Fix:** - Make the page a server component that fetches posts at render time. - Export `metadata` for it. - Add `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with a unique title, description and canonical for each post. - Link each title to its post. - Generate post URLs into the sitemap. ## Medium 3. **`` has no `lang` attribute** (`app/layout.tsx:11`). `geo.config.json:4` says `"en"`. **Fix:** use ``. 4. **The robots.txt AI policy is only partly implemented** (`public/robots.txt:4-5`). - `geo.config.json:6-9` says to allow AI search crawlers and block training crawlers. Only `GPTBot` is blocked. - Other training crawlers fall under `*` and are allowed: `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Meta-ExternalAgent`, `Bytespider` and `cohere-ai`. - Search and retrieval bots (`OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`) are correctly allowed through `*`. - **Fix:** add `Disallow: /` groups for the training bots above. Keep an explicit `Allow: /` for the search bots so a later edit doesn't block them by accident. 5. **robots.txt has no `Sitemap:` line** (`public/robots.txt`). **Fix:** add `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml`. 6. **No structured data anywhere.** - **Fix:** - Add `Organization` and `WebSite` JSON-LD in `app/layout.tsx`. - Add `SoftwareApplication` with `Offer` on the home or pricing page (`app/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx`). - Add `Article` on blog posts. - Add `FAQPage` if you publish an FAQ. - Make sure the markup matches visible text. 7. **Titles and descriptions are weak or duplicated.** - `app/docs/page.tsx:1` ("Docs"), `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` ("Pricing") and `app/thank-you/page.tsx:1` are too generic. - The home description (`app/page.tsx:1`) duplicates the layout default at `app/layout.tsx:4-5`. - **Fix:** use descriptive titles, for example "Ledger pricing: free for up to 3 people". Set `title: { template: '%s | Ledger', default: ... }` in the layout. ## Low 8. **Canonicals are inconsistent.** Home and pricing set them, but `app/docs/page.tsx:1` and the blog don't. **Fix:** set `alternates: { canonical: '/docs' }` and so on. `metadataBase` is already set (`app/layout.tsx:4`), so relative paths work. 9. **There are no `openGraph` or `twitter` metadata fields** in `app/layout.tsx:3-7`. Without them, shared links get weak previews. 10. **The content is very thin for AI citation.** Home (`app/page.tsx:4`), docs (`app/docs/page.tsx:4`) and pricing (`app/pricing/page.tsx:4`) have one sentence each. The pricing page says "Free for up to three people" and gives no paid tiers or prices. **Fix:** add concrete, quotable content. - A plan and price table. - Feature descriptions. - A "what is Ledger" paragraph. - Docs with real steps. 11. **The sitemap has no ``** (`public/sitemap.xml:3-6`). Consider generating it with `app/sitemap.ts`, which also lets you include blog posts. 12. **Optional: add `/llms.txt`.** It's a short markdown summary of the site and its key pages. The benefit is unproven, but it costs little. ## Checked and fine - `/thank-you` is noindex and is not in the sitemap (`app/thank-you/page.tsx:1`). - `data-nosnippet` on the cookie banner (`app/layout.tsx:15`) is a sensible use. - The home page has a single `

` and a canonical. - The nav uses real `` links, so crawlers can follow them (`app/layout.tsx:13`). I haven't changed anything. I can apply items 1–5 and 8 now if you'd like.
